$comment: Completion bar for #215: a recall-before-reveal Study mode. The learner answers first and rates confidence 0-100; only then is the grounded, cited answer revealed as feedback, with an optional one-line self-explanation and a self-grade. Attempts persist in a study_attempts table (migration) and feed a calibration summary (mean confidence vs accuracy: bias and Brier). Every Vault-specific effect stays a hypothesis; the pilot in #218 measures it. Verified failing first: no study module/panel/handler, no test:study.
